<noinclude><pagequality level="1" user="" />{{rh|26|THE GOSPEL|CHA. X.}}</noinclude>{{verse|chapter=10|verse=16}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō the Commemoration of S. Paul, Iun. 30.}}Behold I send you as sheepe in the middes of vvolues. Be ye therfore {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ Wisedom and simplicitie both be necessarie in preachers, Bishops and Priests.}}∷ vvise as serpents, and simple as dooues. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=17}}† And take heede of men. For they vvil deliuer you vp in Councels, and in their synagogs they vvil scourge you. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=18}}† And to Presidents and to ‖ Kings shal you be ledde for my sake, in testimonie to them and the Gentiles. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=19}}† But vvhen they shal deliuer you vp, {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mar. 13, 11. Luc. 12, 11.''}}* take no thought hovv or vvhat to speake: for ‖ it shal be giuen you in that houre vvhat to speake. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=20}}† For it is not you that speake, but the spirit of your father that speaketh in you. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=21}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 21, 16.''}}* The brother also shal deliuer vp the brother to death, and the father the sonne: and the children shal rise vp agaynst the parents, and shal vvorke their death, {{verse|chapter=10|verse=22}}† and you shal be odious to al men for my name. but he that shal perseuêre vnto the end, he shal be saued.⊣

{{verse|chapter=10|verse=23}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō S. Athanasius day. Maij 2.}}And vvhen they shal persecute you in this citie, flee into an other. Amen I say to you, you shal not finish al the cities of Israel, til the sonne of man come.

{{verse|chapter=10|verse=24}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 6, 40.''}}* The Disciple is not aboue the maister, nor the seruant aboue his lord. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=25}}† It suffiseth the disciple that he be as his maister: and the seruant as his lord. If they haue called the goodman of the house Beelzebub, ‖ hovv much more them of his houshold? {{verse|chapter=10|verse=26}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel for some Martyrs, not Bishops.}}Therfore feare ye not them. For nothing is hid, that shal not be reuealed: and secrete, that shal not be knovven. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=27}}† That vvhich I speake to you in the darke, speake ye in the light: and that vvhich you heare in the eare, preache ye vpon the house toppes. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=28}}† And {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=∷ A goodly cōfort for Christians and Catholikes and al good men, in the persecutiōs of Turke, of Heretikes, of al Wicked men.}}∷ feare ye not them that kil the body, and are not able to kil the soul: but rather feare him that can destroy both soul and body into hel.⊣

{{verse|chapter=10|verse=29}}† Are not tvvo sparovves sold for a farthing: and not one of them shal fall vpon the ground vvithout your father? {{verse|chapter=10|verse=30}}† But your very heares of the head are al numbered. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=31}}† Feare not therfore: better are you then many sparovves. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=32}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mar. 8, 38. Luc 9, 26. 12, 8.''}}* Euery one therfore that shal ‖ confesse me before men, I also vvil confesse him before my father vvhich is in heauen. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=33}}† But he that shal denie me before men, I also vvil denie him before my father vvhich is in heauen. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=34}}† {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=The Gospel vpō a Martyrs day that is not a Bishop.}}Do not ye thinke {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Luc. 12, 51.''}}* that I came to send peace into the earth: I came ‖ not to send peace, but the sword. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=35}}† For I came to separate {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=''Mich. 7, 6.''}}* man agaynst his father, and the daughter agaynst her mother, and the daughter in lavv agaynst her mother in lavv. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=36}}† And a mans enemies, they of his ovvne houshold. {{verse|chapter=10|verse=37}}† He that loueth father or<noinclude>{{rh|||mother}}</noinclude>
